card.title: PlayStation 4 Error Codes & Common Fault Diagnostics Guide

claims.statement: If the PS4 stays at 99mA standby current with no boot, it indicates a bad southbridge, and the 32Khz crystal should be checked for oscillation.
claims.evidence: Research Resear Standby boot sequence diagnostic current draws
claims.quote: If it stays at 99mA with no boot it could mean that the southbridge is bad. Check the 32Khz crystal if it oscillates. If the 32Khz signal is missing, then replace the southbridge clean flux of the board.

claims.statement: A 1-second Blue Light Of Death (BLOD) can be caused by a bad APU, shorted capacitors near the APU, bad solder joints under the APU, or a faulty power supply failing to create +12Von.
claims.quote: 1 second then off Bad APU - Check capacitors near APU for shorts Bad solder joint under the APU - Reflow or reball the APU. Bad power supply – Check if +12Von is created by the power supply

claims.statement: Error CE-35888-2 typically indicates a Renesas IC problem in the disc drive circuit which is generally not repairable.
claims.evidence: Troubleshooting section for error code CE-35888-2
claims.quote: Error CE-35888-2 While the disc drive itself may be functioning, encountering this error typically indicates a Renesas IC problem, which is not repairable.

claims.statement: Controller sync failures or issues with controllers not syncing in safe mode can point to a faulty Wi-Fi/Bluetooth IC or a corrupted NOR flash memory.
claims.quote: The game controllers does not sync Problem with the Wifi ic. If the controllers do not sync in safe mode, then the NOR flash IC could be faulty.

claims.statement: Corrupted NOR software can cause BLOD and can be validated or rebuilt using the PS4 NOR Validator software after desoldering the NOR chip.
claims.evidence: NOR flash diagnostic and repair procedure
claims.quote: Corrupted NOR software. Desolder NOR chip, validate or rebuild the software using The PS4 NOR Validator software.

claims.statement: If an RTC battery voltage drops below +2.8V, it can indicate a shorted southbridge.
claims.quote: Check if RTC battery is > +2,8V if it is empty it can indicate a shorted southbridge

claims.statement: The Panasonic MN864729 HDMI transmitter encoder is frequently faulty when there is no picture displayed.
claims.quote: Panasonic MN864729 HDMI transmitter - front HDMI Encoder Is faulty most of the time when there is no picture

procedure: Check the hard drive by testing and connecting it to a PC if experiencing WLOD or no display.
Test the power supply by connecting the small white connector (+5 Vstby) and pressing power to see if +12 Von is outputted.
Verify NOR flash memory integrity using the PS4 NOR Validator software after desoldering the chip.
Connect the controller with a USB cable and test syncing in Safe Mode to isolate Bluetooth/Wi-Fi module issues versus NOR flash problems.
Inspect thermal pads on RAM modules and thermal paste on the APU if the console exhibits overheating symptoms (max fan RPM, beeping, red LED).

measurements.context: RTC battery voltage check for shorted southbridge

cautions: SOURCE RISK: Removing the mainboard shield with hot air can cause solder near HDMI filters to bridge or disconnect.
card.caveats: Diagnostic indicators like current draws and error codes must be verified against specific board revisions as component layouts vary across PS4 models.
